title.narrative: Strengthening the Capacity of the Prime Minister’s Office in Yemen

description.narrative: This project aims to enhance the Prime Ministrys ability to implement national priorities and reforms, ensuring effective resource allocation and performance monitoring to achieve measurable results. It addresses Yemens humanitarian and development crisis, focusing on building capacity within three key units: the Rapid Response Unit, Transparency Reinforcement Unit, and Policies and Strategies Unit. These units support the Prime Minister and government ministries in implementing critical reforms, with a focus on restoring state capacity, combating corruption, and improving public services. A three-year transition strategy will integrate the temporary units into existing government structures, using digital solutions for efficiency and transparency. The project is committed to long-term development, peacebuilding, and rigorous monitoring and evaluation.
